instruction: Open or import the initial file(s) from the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\outer_plate.step. Create a Profile or Contour outside-boundary operation for C:\Users\User\Desktop\outer_plate.step. Set the Coordinate System origin at the part top-face center. Use T1, a 6 mm flat end mill, to machine the outside profile down to Z=0.000 mm. Apply 0.2 mm radial stock and one finish pass. Tool definition: T1 is a 6 mm flat end mill for Profile/Contour milling, S9000 rpm, F650 mm/min. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-2.nc.
